groups.reason: Surrounding conditions of development and interaction are selected, not ecology or a computing environment; the EN and ZH paraphrases preserve conditions rather than substituting nature.
The masculine capacity-unit frame gives exactly one cubic decimetre; FR, EN and ZH preserve the unit and exclude the separate feminine funeral noun and bottle metonymy.
Assurance pleine et entière supports certainty about a thing; the explanations concern a person's complete conviction, not an objectively proven fact or the separate permanence sense.
The lowercase French adjective relates to Israel as a country; the nationality noun and israélite are not substituted. Masculine singular and israélienne remain distinct.
Sharing another's suffering by perception or knowledge is preserved in both translations; the selected empathy meaning is not reduced to the separate pitié analogy.
Action or state of being apart from someone is preserved; no legal divorce, state/church separation or mathematical separation is inferred.

The masculine invariant noun and old wooden-board meaning are accurately represented, but fixed line 19 says vieilli. Contemporary corroboration establishes only technical bookbinding, not an everyday noun use; all four fields fail frozen ordinary-scope eligibility.
Séparer en parties is ordinary transitive division, without equal-size mathematical division, typography or divided opinion; 分成若干部分 preserves that scope.
The wind instrument's air-edge vibration and finger-controlled openings are preserved; no reed, organ stop, glass, bread, interjection or single flute subtype is substituted.

Selected line 34 supports formal objection against something regarded as invalid or illegal. The contre construction is intransitive despite the broad transitive article header. Modern Le Robert confirms formal opposition; the narrower source conditions remain explicit in all three meanings.

The French variant line binds exact base-ball to baseball, with its own nominal IPA. Two teams of nine and four bases are supported; the author's absolute nine-inning ending is corrected because tied games can continue. The explanation keeps nine innings as the normal format rather than a mandatory ending.

Unloading the load from a vehicle, boat or pack animal is supported, including the vehicle-object construction in the subdefinition; discharge of a weapon, release from an obligation and pronominal delegation are excluded.
Regular continual recurrence is the selected ordinary noun; no numeric hertz measurement or probability is introduced. The ZH text retains recurrence rather than silently selecting a scientific rate.
The first feminine noun is a haughty arrogant manner; English morgue as a corpse facility belongs to the second frame and is excluded from the EN meaning.
The brother's or sister's daughter is preserved, with 侄女 and 外甥女 explicitly covering both Chinese kinship paths; cousin and spouse extensions remain excluded.
Prendre patience/attendre avec patience is explicitly intransitive; no direct object or invented patience-causing meaning is introduced.
The handled material-moving tool and thick-mixture use are retained; the blade shape is not restricted to one subtype, and the mechanical shovel, dustpan, kiss and fall senses are excluded.
Publication périodique with developed treatment of varied subjects is selected; the noun is not a revoir participle, inspection or stage revue. EN journal and ZH 期刊/杂志 fit the same publication sense.
The adjective's cassé/rompu sense and adjective-bound fr-accord-rég IPA are selected, rather than borrowing the nearby briser participle frame or exhausted figurative use.
The plant textile fibre around cotton seeds is selected; EN and ZH preserve both the plant origin and seed filaments without selecting a garment, dog or regional stalk sense.

The self-rising firework in line 16 is a modern ordinary rocket use confirmed by Le Robert. Accepted meanings select the stick-guided powder-filled type; the historical hand-thrown subtype and the author's Chinese ignition-scope mismatch are excluded. Spacecraft, weapon fuse and CFC cartography wording supply no field.
The generic staying-in-place/firm-state/not-varying adjective is preserved, not graph theory, forestry, finance or a software-release label; stable is both masculine and feminine.

Commencer is selected with the source's intransitive or indirect-transitive restriction. The attached Académie reference corroborates the construction only; its prose is not copied. Both translations retain the prepositional complement and exclude a direct object within this selected use.
The source's familier ordinary/undistinguished adjective sense is explicit in all languages; arbitrary-choice or negative any constructions are separate uses and not mixed into the explanation.

The familiar key-operated lock mechanism is selected despite the domain label serrurerie; the everyday object is not the specialist railway safety interlock. Both recorded nominal pronunciations are admissible; one is selected.
A bounded field of study/work to which a person devotes themselves is selected; ZH 专长 is qualified by the explicit professional field, with no food, drug, mortgage or budget sense introduced.

The author conflates military rank with holding supreme command. Fixed French subdefinition line 35 instead establishes the current French naval rank above vice-amiral d'escadre and equivalent to général d'armée. All meanings select that ordinary rank vocabulary with France explicit; no claim that every holder commands all naval forces remains.
Transitive identification by words or marks is preserved; appointment, symbolic representation and determination are not folded into the selected use.
The worried person's lack of peace of mind is selected; both translations remain ordinary worry/uneasiness rather than pathology, obsolete physical restlessness or the regional furniture noun.

The French advanced-education institution sense is supported at line 18 and independently corroborated by Le Robert's école supérieure sense; no general elementary school, territorial district or learned society is substituted. EN training and ZH 培训 remain advanced within the sentence.

The noun at line 106 means a person who likes making others laugh. The adjective, abstract comic genre and neighbouring désuet professional-humour sense are excluded; masculine/feminine noun agreement is recorded.
The small or medium stone sense, masculine and irregular plural cailloux, is preserved in both translations; gemstones, reef, head, lens and regional animal meanings are excluded.

The nonreligious adjective at line 10 permits very great power; unlimited divine omnipotence is the separate line-20 sense. Singular tout-puissant and feminine toute-puissante are evidenced by the compound-agreement template.
The exact French noun paye gives salary/remuneration for work and explicitly records /pɛj/ alongside /pɛ/. No paie respelling, payer verb form, debtor or long-period colloquial sense is substituted.
Relating to art is preserved, without a claim of talent, aesthetic merit or a specific medium; the unchanged masculine/feminine spelling is recorded.

The French transitive methodical-examination definition is selected. /ɛk.splɔ.ʁe/ is written notation in the French pronunciation section, not the English explorer noun or its audio. DAF8 at line 112 belongs to that English section and cannot establish a French original-work layer.
The ordinary wrist joint connecting forearm and hand is selected despite the anatomy domain label; the clothing cuff is a distinct metonymic sense. 手腕 preserves the same body-part meaning.
